dispatch: the change-detector gate asks of each assertion a change writes what can make it fail

The gate's extractor draws each `assert` and each `pytest.raises` given a
`match` whose lines a change writes in a test module, with the case it sits
in, the module-level statements binding what that case reads, and the
program's definition of each name the case reads off an absolute import,
one level deep, read once per change. Its
question is docs/style/testing.md's: can the assertion fail other than by
someone editing the value it restates. Its labelled set is drawn from the
reviews of this repository's pull requests at the heads they read, the
falsifier pair first, and it runs in shadow until it is calibrated.

Refs Aetf/kluster-ops#917
